plain: Without a set end or limit

webster.text: Without any settled limitation; as space indefinitely extended.

example.quote: It is so vaguely and indefinitely expressed, that its latitude cannot be ascertained.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 21, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
